messages.author: Kenneth Huang
messages.body:
Hi all,
Hopefully I'm missing something obvious, but does anyone know where the
parameters for norlecuine (Nle) are in ff99sb-ildn? I've managed to find it
in ff15ipq, but was curious to see if I couldn't use the ildn version.
Best,
Kenneth
-- 
Ask yourselves, all of you, what power would hell have if those imprisoned
here could not dream of heaven?

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Jun 10, 2021, Kenneth Huang wrote:
>
>Hopefully I'm missing something obvious, but does anyone know where the
>parameters for norlecuine (Nle) are in ff99sb-ildn? I've managed to find it
>in ff15ipq, but was curious to see if I couldn't use the ildn version.
Most Amber protein force fields, including ffxxSB, don't have entries for
NLE. Same holds for ff99sb-ildn, which is a (somewhat old) variant of
FF99SB. So, you are not missing anything obvious.
....dac
